div.head: Quadr Ded 11
div.ab: Tunc auariciæ stridulum murmur et habendi praua sitis inhorruit; tunc luxuriæ dissoluentis sordidiora genera, tunc promiscuæ libidines et incesta mollicies, tunc semiulci puerorum suauii et quæ mulieres pati miseræ libidinis coguntur incendiis et ó tanta criminum reticenda flagitia præposteris passionum incentiuis abundarunt!
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 529–530 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
